_comment: DIFF-10 — photographs for the bundled fixtures, and through them for the once-ever demo
journey a new customer sees on first launch (PersistenceController.seedDemoJourneyIfFreshInstall).
Kept as a SIDECAR here rather than as a `photos` array inside Fixtures/recovered/*.json: those
files are the recovered pre-Supabase archive, declared read-only in project.yml, and they stay
byte-identical. Keyed by journey slug; `file` names a JPEG in this same directory, bundled as a
resource and copied into the app's media library at seed time by FixtureMedia.
CONTENT CAVEAT: these three images are the repo's existing 1024x1024 generated hero art
(public/hero-images/*.png, re-encoded as JPEG). They are illustrative scenery for the place, NOT
photographs from the trek, and the repo contains no photographs to use instead. Dropping real
trek photographs in is a file copy plus an edit to this manifest — no code change.

kilimanjaro.caption: Kilimanjaro from the plains — the mountain you spend a week walking up.

inca-trail.caption: Machu Picchu from the Sun Gate.
